title: Redcraft-AFKLobby
description: AFKLobby automatically moves inactive players to a dedicated AFK area after five minutes of no movement, storing their previous location in a JSON file.
body:
### Overview
AFKLobby is a lightweight and reliable Bukkit/Paper plugin designed to automatically manage inactive players on your server. After five minutes of no movement, players are safely teleported to a dedicated AFK area, keeping your main world clean and preventing unwanted AFK farming or clutter. The plugin requires no complex setup and works instantly after defining an AFK lobby location.
### How It Works
When a player becomes inactive, AFKLobby stores their exact position — including world, coordinates, yaw, and pitch — in a clean JSON file. After five minutes of inactivity, the player is moved to the AFK lobby set by an administrator using /setafklobby . This ensures that idle players are kept out of active gameplay areas, farms, or events without disrupting the server experience.
### Player Control
Players can individually enable or disable AFK teleportation using /afklobby true  or /afklobby false .
If disabled, the plugin completely ignores them, allowing builders, staff members, or players who need to remain still to avoid being teleported. This makes the system flexible and player‑friendly.
### Returning From AFK
As soon as a player moves again, AFKLobby instantly detects the movement and teleports them back to their previously saved location.
This also works after logging out:
If a player disconnects while inside the AFK lobby, the plugin automatically returns them to their original location when they log back in, ensuring a seamless and intuitive experience.
### Data Storage
All plugin data is stored in a single JSON file, including:
• 	AFK toggle state for each player
• 	Last known locations
• 	AFK lobby position
This makes the plugin extremely easy to manage without requiring a traditional configuration file.
### Compatibility
AFKLobby is fully compatible with:
• 	Bukkit
• 	Paper
• 	Minecraft version 1.21.9
It is optimized for performance and suitable for both small and large servers.
### Why Use AFKLobby?
AFKLobby provides a clean, automated, and player‑friendly AFK system with:
• 	Zero setup complexity
• 	Full player control
• 	Automatic return teleportation
• 	Safe AFK handling
• 	Lightweight performance
It’s the perfect solution for servers that want a professional AFK management system without unnecessary overhead.
